research_insights.selected_model: (r, Q) — Fixed Reorder Point with Economic Order Quantity
research_insights.selection_rationale: The material exhibits continuous, high-volume demand with significant variability. A fixed reorder-point policy provides immediate trigger-based replenishment that responds to real-time stock depletion, while the EOQ balances the high ordering cost against holding cost. The MOQ of 20,379 is well below the EOQ of 260,289 so no MOQ-driven distortion occurs.
